reviews.specification:
Implement measured-food-preservation@1, individually learned in 3 rounds for preparation, moisture/storage interpretation and interruption handling. Dependencies: personal food-assay mastery for calibrated readings; actual owned food; a reachable intact drying tray with verified usable area and loading capacity. Existing apparatus is not presumed accessible or serviceable. No heat, fuel, containers or replacement supplies are granted. Public strict schema: {mode:inspect|prepare|read|resume|cancel|remove, project:string, target:string, apparatus:string, quantityTenths:integer>=0}; require exact persistent identities, accepting one item:/object: prefix, never resource aliases; use empty identities and zero quantity where unused. Inspect costs one round/0.2 energy and reports accessibility, tray area/capacity, provenance and unresolved condition. Prepare requires a new own project, positive food allocation and reachable tray; two paid rounds/0.5 energy each spread and manually soften the batch, with no cutting-tool assumption. First round allocates the real food to owner-retained, location-bound tray escrow; conserve all food units, nutrients and toxins, and record opening and preparation damage. No label-only products or new food diversity.
Add a versioned physical drying mechanism shared with assay, eating, carrying and spoilage. Persist original food identity, consumed-input lineage, represented food units, dry solids, water mass, nutrient/toxin totals, deterioration remaining, moisture history, exposure, contamination and actual tray occupancy. For previously unmodelled berry/root inputs initialize water fractions to 0.85/0.75 of represented mass as explicit model assumptions, not measured evidence; do not overwrite existing assay water/mass state. Other composition remains unsupported until a physical initialization is supplied. Atmospheric humidity must be actual shared weather state; if absent, introduce a documented ordinary-weather default RH 0.65, separately from soil moisture, with weather updates affecting all exposed batches consistently. Let water fraction w=W/(W+D), equilibrium e=clamp(0.10+0.25*RH,0.10,0.35). Each exposed round transfers water toward equilibrium by at most 0.025*occupiedArea*clamp((temperature-5)/20,0,2) mass units, capped by distance from equilibrium; rain adds actual intercepted water. Account evaporated water in an atmospheric sink. Occupied area is allocated tray area; loading above 0.2 represented food-mass units per area prevents effective spreading and drying. No invented tray area or clearance. Track shared tray geometry, other loads, collision, overhead cover and actual rain interception; food adds mass and occupies capacity but creates no shelter.
Continue existing spoilage during preparation. Thereafter multiply the existing ambient deterioration decrement by clamp(0.15+0.85*(w/initialWaterFraction),0.15,1.5); never reset remaining deterioration or erase existing spoilage, toxins or contamination. Opening adds a persistent 1.1 deterioration multiplier. This law provides a measurable reduction only when real moisture loss outweighs opening cost; drying is not sterilization. Spoiled material remains spoiled and cannot regain food status. Retained nutrition/toxin totals follow actual remaining food units; water loss changes carrying mass, not calories or toxin totals. Storage remains open-tray storage, with continuing weather-dependent drying, rewetting and deterioration. Removal ends tray processing but retains composition and deterioration; subsequent exposed storage uses the same moisture exchange, with actual occupied surface area or conservative zero drying area when enclosed/unknown. Report conditional remaining-life estimates using current measured moisture and current weather, uncertainty and no guarantee of future conditions.
Read costs one round/0.2 energy; calibrated mass requires actual reachable compatible balance and its existing paid-reading contract, not a remote free measurement. Direct inspection reports observable deterioration and model-based moisture bounds separately from measurements. Completion of preparation starts passive drying; completion of a trial requires a paid reading demonstrating a reduced deterioration rate while the batch survives, or records spoilage/failure. Persist exact paid stages, remaining work, escrow owner, apparatus allocation and process status. Insufficient energy/access pauses unpaid active work; unattended physical drying, weather and spoilage continue. Resume pays only remaining stages. Movement interrupts attended work, not an already installed passive process. Explicit cancellation or actor death cancels active work and ends the owned process controller, releases surviving tray food once at its actual location, clears occupancy once, and retains composition, damage and provenance; no deletion, duplication or refund of effort. Global simulation pause advances nothing. Public implementation, study and use remain separate; migration grants no objects, mastery, experimental evidence or recovered food. Declare preservation-inspected, preservation-progress, preservation-reading, preservation-completed and preservation-stopped, with operation ID, owner, inputs, paid energy, remaining work and observable outcomes; subscribe to died, weather-changed, spoiled and relevant apparatus-loss events.
